source: Shot Pattern club dispersion screens, measured by the Golf project chat; transcribed from docs/SPEC-caddie-UI.md §5.4 (UI Addendum v1, 2026-09-27).
method: Ellipse fitted to the solid 80% outline, scaled by the Width × Depth labels (PW and 9-iron checked isotropic within 1.1%), offset measured from the target cross.
frame: Shot Pattern club plot: +x right, +y short. wYds is the full axis at tiltDeg clockwise from +x; hYds the perpendicular axis. dx, dy = ellipse centre relative to the target cross.

entries.note: screen scrolled, top of ellipse estimated; mixes tee (248) and fairway (224)
